name: Mudrock Soup and Bugs
summary: In Theramore, Morgan Stern hopes to win Stormwind City over with a new dish. The trek through Dustwallow Marsh is too much for Morgan Stern, so you gather Mudrock tongues for Mudrock Soup and Bugs.

sections.title: A Dish in the Making
sections.body: Morgan Stern is gathering ingredients for a new dish in Theramore. A long trek through Dustwallow Marsh is more than Morgan Stern expects to survive, so you hunt Mudrock turtles. Their tongues are needed first.

sections.title: Forked Tongues
sections.body: Mudrock turtles roam the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, mostly around the bay. Morgan Stern wants forked tongues in particular, having heard they bring a distinct flavor to the dish.

sections.title: Toward the Table
sections.body: Morgan Stern will try different ways of cooking the tongues to find what best brings out their taste. Morgan Stern hopes to make a dish fit for the Blue Recluse in Stormwind.

faq.q: Who is asking for the turtle tongues?
aliases: who starts mudrock soup and bugs
faq.answer: Morgan Stern, in Theramore, is making a dish called Mudrock Soup and Bugs.

faq.q: Where can the Mudrock turtles be found?
faq.answer: Mudrock turtles roam along the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, mostly around the bay.

faq.q: Why does Morgan Stern want forked tongues specifically?
faq.answer: Morgan Stern has heard forked tongues carry a distinct flavor wanted in the dish.

faq.q: Why won't Morgan Stern gather the ingredients in person?
faq.answer: Morgan Stern doubts they would survive a long trek through Dustwallow Marsh.
The next step is called ... and Bugs.
